title: The Cat in the Box
lines: Dad got a big box from the van.
A tan cat pops up in it!
The cat naps in the box.
Tim tugs at the box. The cat digs in.
Tim naps on the rug. Dad nods.

questions.ask: What pops up when Tim tips the box?
questions.listenFor: A tan cat. It is stated in the story, so if they guess, send them back to find the line rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Why does Tim nap on the rug and not in the box?
questions.listenFor: The cat got there first and would not budge. You are listening for them to link the two parts of the story, not just "he was tired."

questions.ask: Do you think Tim minds letting the cat have the box? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. You want a reason tied to the story - "no, he let the cat have it" or "yes, he tugged at the box first."
